policy.sourceBacked: Every emitted row is transcribed from the pack's named official source.
policy.officialImport: The pack is reproduced from an official page, installed default preset, or official section named in provenance.
policy.manualReview: Browser-sourced secondary data is displayed only with an explicit manual-review status and a review-report entry.
policy.catalogOnly: Product remains discoverable, but contains zero shortcut rows until verified.
policy.curated: A reviewed macOS default-key set assembled from named product documentation, with its evidence boundary retained.
policy.legacyReviewed: Existing hand-curated rows pass structural and macOS-key audits without an official per-pack completeness claim.
